title: This Fish Looks Like a Rock and Has 13 Venomous Spines

scenes.text: This fish looks like a rock and has 13 venomous spines.
Its bumpy skin looks like a rock covered in coral.
It doesn't swim away. It just sits there, hidden in the sand.
Step on it, and its spines inject venom.
It's called the most venomous fish in the world.
It looks like a rock. It isn't.

description:
The reef stonefish has 13 venomous spines and looks just like a rock.
It's called the most venomous fish in the world.
Would you have spotted it?
first_comment: It looks like a rock. Would you have spotted it?
